thought.text: Let me do a thorough verification - test login and the app's authenticated endpoint.

reasoning_content:
The app is running. HTTP 302 redirect (expected, redirects to login). Login page title confirms OpenProject. Admin credentials admin/admin. Let me verify a bit more - check the redirect target and try logging in maybe. Let me do a more thorough verification.

Let me test that the login works by attempting authentication. Actually let's just verify the home page redirects to login and the application responds properly.

action.command:
echo "=== Root redirect location ==="
curl -sI http://localhost:8080/ | grep -i location
echo "=== Login page ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "login page HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/login
echo "=== Assets/health ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "health HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/health_check
echo "=== CSRF login test ==="
COOKIE=/tmp/op_cookies.txt
TOKEN=$(curl -s -c $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/login | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "token acquired: ${#TOKEN}"
curl -s -b $COOKIE -c $COOKIE -o /tmp/login_resp.html -w "login POST HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" \
  -d "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" -d "username=admin" -d "password=admin" \
  http://localhost:8080/login
echo "=== Authenticated check ==="
curl -s -b $COOKIE -o /dev/null -w "my page HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/my/page
curl -s -b $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/my/page | grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1
